messages:
aisha: Heads up, CI turned red on the serializer snapshot tests after my PR (4923). Build: https://ci.internal/build/3421
CI Bot: Job 3421 failed on step `unit-tests (snapshots)` — 3 failing snapshots. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/3421/logs
aisha: failing test is `tests/test_prompt_serializer.py::test_prompt_serialization_snapshot`
devon: on it, will try a rerun
jamie: if it's flaky a rerun might pass, but if diff is consistent we'll need a quick triage
aisha: I'm going to trigger a rerun now
CI Bot: Re-run requested for job 3421 -> new job 3422
CI Bot: Job 3422 finished — still failed, same test. Attaching the snapshot diff snippet:
```
- expected: "system: you are helpful"
+ actual:   "system: you are helpful\\n"
```
devon: that looks like an extra trailing newline in the serializer output
jamie: which commit changed serializer? @olga can you help bisect?
olga: I can take a quick bisect. devon — what's the exact local command you use to run that single snapshot test?
devon: `pytest tests/test_prompt_serializer.py::test_prompt_serialization_snapshot -q --maxfail=1`
devon: to update locally (if you need to): `SNAPSHOT_UPDATE=1 pytest tests/test_prompt_serializer.py::test_prompt_serialization_snapshot`
jamie: note: do NOT update snapshots unless we're sure the newline is intended. That would hide a real regression.
aisha: agreed — I already opened an interim patch that strips trailing newlines in the serializer output, but won't merge until bisect confirms root cause: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4934
olga: bisecting locally now. Repro step I used: `python -c "from utils.serializer import serialize; print(repr(serialize({'role':'system','text':'you are helpful'})))"` — shows `'system: you are helpful\\n'` after commit `abc123`
jamie: looks like commit abc123 introduced preserving original trailing newline when joining parts. We probably changed join glue.
devon: proposed fix: normalize snapshot generation by stripping trailing newlines before asserting in tests, or better, normalize serializer to avoid unexpected trailing newlines. FWIW I prefer fixing serializer to be stable across callers.
aisha: +1 to fixing at serializer level, but patch should be minimal and well-tested. Also add a unit test covering the newline case.
jamie: I'll review a small PR for `.rstrip('\\n')` on the serialized output before snapshot generation, with a short note in the changelog.
olga: I pushed a tiny bisect patch to my branch that normalizes output and ran the single test locally — it passes.
devon: pushed PR 4935 with the serializer normalization and added a test (did not update snapshots). CI rerun requested: https://ci.internal/build/3430
CI Bot: Job 3430 queued
CI Bot: Job 3430 passed — unit-tests (snapshots) all green; snapshots unchanged
aisha: thank you both. I'll link this in the release notes and close the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
devon: leaving a note in PR that if anyone intentionally relies on trailing newline semantics they should comment before merge.
jamie: closing thread — feel free to reopen if we see more snapshot drift related to serializer.
